scripts.dev: pnpm --parallel --stream --filter backend --filter frontend --filter vendor-portal --filter admin-console run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend --filter frontend --filter vendor-portal --filter admin-console --workspace-concurrency=1 run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter backend --filter frontend --filter vendor-portal --filter admin-console --workspace-concurrency=1 run lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter backend --filter frontend --filter vendor-portal --filter admin-console --workspace-concurrency=1 run test
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: pnpm --filter frontend exec playwright test --config playwright.smoke.config.ts
scripts.build:frontends: pnpm --filter frontend --filter vendor-portal --filter admin-console --workspace-concurrency=1 run build
